name: Mexico
description: Mexico is a federal presidential republic and Latin America's second-largest economy. Deeply integrated with the United States through USMCA supply chains, it is a manufacturing hub for automotive, electronics and aerospace alongside oil, mining and massive remittance inflows. Thirty-one states plus Mexico City share power in a democratic federal system consolidated since 2000.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Mexico's actor space from Porfirian railways and post-revolutionary state enterprises through maquiladora industrialization and NAFTA integration to nearshoring manufacturers and fintech entrants.

works.title: Maquiladora and Remittance Network
works.description: Network analysis of border assembly plants, auto-electronics suppliers, and household remittance circuits binding US labor markets to Mexican regions.

works.title: Federal State Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of thirty-one states and the capital, fiscal centralization, and the north-center-south development gradient.
